scripts.dev:main: tsup src/main/main.ts src/preload/preload.ts --format cjs --out-dir dist-electron --watch --external electron
scripts.dev:electron: wait-on http-get://127.0.0.1:5173 file:dist-electron/main/main.js file:dist-electron/preload/preload.js && cross-env NODE_ENV=development VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 electron .
scripts.build: bun run build:renderer && bun run build:main
scripts.build:main: tsup src/main/main.ts src/preload/preload.ts --format cjs --out-dir dist-electron --external electron
scripts.dist: bun run build && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --publish never
scripts.dist:mac: bun run build && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --mac dmg --publish never
scripts.dist:mac:x64: bun run build && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --mac dmg --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:mac:arm64: bun run build && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --mac dmg --arm64 --publish never
scripts.test:e2e: bun run build && bunx playwright test
scripts.precommit: bun run lint && bun run tsc && bun run test && bun run tscontext && git add .tscontext/code-context.toon .tscontext/code-context.md
